title: Verify: AdminApp execution handlers call the client and reload unit tests
summary: Unit tests with a mocked fetch for approve, retry and reject
description: Add game/frontend/tests/adminActions.test.tsx modelled on tests/adminExecution.test.tsx. It stubs fetch by URL and Bearer token, counts the GET calls to the executions endpoint to prove the reload, and uses fixtures from tests/fixtures/api.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Approve, Reject and Retry each POST to the matching URL with the Bearer token
Each action is followed by a second GET of the executions endpoint
technical_constraints: Fixtures mirror execution.Execution JSON in backend/internal/execution/execution.go; routes mirror backend/internal/server/server.go

steps.action: Export awaitingExecutionFixture as { ...executionFixture, status: 'AWAITING_APPROVAL' }, mirroring execution.Execution in backend/internal/execution/execution.go.
steps.expected: Fixture importable by tests and type-check passes

steps.symbol: new: describe('AdminApp execution actions') / it('Approve posts and reloads')
steps.action: Copy the stubFetch and enterToken helpers from adminExecution.test.tsx, extended to answer POST /api/v1/admin/executions/exec-1/approve with json(awaitingExecutionFixture). Render AdminApp, enter token 'secret', click the Approve button and assert fetch was called with that URL, method POST and Authorization 'Bearer secret'. Then await waitFor that the GET executions call count is 2.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t Approve

steps.action: Same as the approve test with status AWAITING_APPROVAL, clicking the Reject button and asserting the /reject URL with POST and a second executions GET.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t Reject

steps.action: Use failedExecutionFixture, click the Retry button and assert POST to /api/v1/admin/executions/exec-1/retry and a second executions GET.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t Retry
